title: Crash Recovery
description:
When an aircraft crashes and can’t be used anymore what happens to it? Crash recovery team chief, TSgt Bradley Parker explains how his team is using an old crashed F-16 as a re-certification and training aid to stay ready for real-world emergencies.
Suggested lead: 
In addition to responding to runway emergencies, crash recovery 
Personnel also recover aircraft that have crashed in unusual 
Locations. SSgt Jael Laborn takes us to the scene where one of 
these jets is being moved for disassembly.
Suggested tag:
Crash recovery personnel also specialize in providing 
maintenance on rare aircraft systems.
